description:
Configure the Jitsi Meet deployment for a restrictive compliance environment. You must modify the `custom-interface_config.js` to: 
1. Disable the mobile app promotion (`MOBILE_APP_PROMO` set to `false`).
2. Redirect the watermark link (`JITSI_WATERMARK_LINK`) to `https://intranet.securehealth.com`.
3. Redirect the streaming help link (`LIVE_STREAMING_HELP_LINK`) to `https://intranet.securehealth.com/streaming`.
4. Modify the `TOOLBAR_BUTTONS` list to remove the 'invite' and 'security' buttons, while keeping other standard buttons like 'microphone', 'camera', 'chat', 'desktop', etc.

You must create/edit `/home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/custom-interface_config.js`, restart the web container, and verify the changes in the browser.
